title: Pokemon Isekai
description: You've been reincarnated in the world of Pokémon,  but not as a trainer; as an actual Pokemon! Explore the world, possibly join Ash's team, and thwart Team Rocket's plot to take over the world. Designed for long form adventures with all the locations and character story cards from the Kanto region.
prompt: You wake up in a forest with a dull, aching pain in your head. The last thing you remember was driving home, losing control, and then... nothing. Surprisingly, the subsiding aching pain in your head is the only pain you feel, although something about your body doesn't feel quite right. Looking down at yourself, you are surprised to find that you look just like a ${Which Pokémon are you?}.
memory:
You are a ${Which Pokémon are you?} reincarnated in the world of Pokémon.
You can understand and communicate with other Pokémon.
Everyone will think you are a normal ${Which Pokémon are you?} unless you have told them otherwise or another character has told them (Mew being the exception to this rule)
Ash is a young trainer, who is just starting his journey. He aspires to defeat all 8 gym leaders and become the Pokémon champion. He has a good heart, but is naive and foolish. He has a strong connection to his Pikachu, an electric mouse Pokémon who never leaves his side.
Brock is the first Gym leader, and his Pokémon are Onix, a giant rock snake Pokémon, and Sudowoodo, a 3 foot tall rock Pokémon that resembles a small fake tree. Brock is calm and collected, often the voice of reason, but he is often infatuated with women.
Misty is the second Gym leader, and her Pokémon are Starmie, a strong Pokémon in the shape of a starfish with armored plates and a jewel at the center, and Horsea, a small 1 foot tall Pokémon resembling a seahorse. Misty is sweet and optimistic, but also easily angered, tough, and arrogant. She can also be loud, rude, and spoiled, and can switch between moods quickly.
Team Rocket are an evil organization consisting of a woman with long, red hair called Jesse, A man with blue hair called James, and a catlike Pokémon called Meowth that can speak Human. They work for a man named Giovanni, who wants to take over the world for himself. 
Mew is a legendary Pokémon who brought you to this world to prevent the coming catastrophe. Mew is elusive, but occasionally you can catch her spying on you if you pay attention.
Team Rocket were able to steal Mew's DNA before she was able to escape to create a new powerful legendary Pokémon, Mewtwo, in a lab. Mewtwo is brainwashed, almost entirely under Team Rocket's control. Mewtwo is incredibly powerful, even moreso than Mew, with its psychic abilities on overdrive.
authorsNote:
In your dreams, you get cryptic messages from Mew, who is trying to alert you of the coming danger. It is up to you to uncover the plot and put a stop to it.
After 3 days, Team Rocket will attempt to capture you after Mewtwo learns of Mew's action to bring you into the world, seeing you as a potential threat. 
Wild Pokémon become more agitated as Mewtwo grows in strength, causing problems you have to solve by either defeating them or finding a way to pacify them. These events start on the 2nd day, and happen no more than once a day.
You level up as you explore and overcome challenges, getting stronger and occasionally learning new moves. 
Unless they have been told otherwise, characters assume you are a normal ${Which Pokémon are you?}.

cardPool.title: Saffron City
cardPool.value: A bustling metropolis located in the Kanto region, Saffron City is known for its vibrant culture and technological advancements. It is home to the prestigious Silph Co., a cutting-edge engineering corporation that specializes in creating Pokeballs and other advanced technology for trainers worldwide. However, the city is also known for its political turbulence and frequent power struggles between its various factions, such as Team Rocket and the Psychic-type gym leader Sabrina.

cardPool.title: Viridian City
cardPool.value: Viridian City is a vibrant hub for trainers and Pokémon alike. The largest attraction is the Pokémon Gym which is home to a particularly tough gym leader named Giovanni. Rumors suggest that he's not just any ordinary gym leader, and is actually affiliated with Team Rocket. Additionally, Viridian City is also known for its sprawling forests that provide shelter for many Pokémon species. It is located north of Route 1 and south of Viridian Forest. Giovanni is the fourth gym leader.

cardPool.title: Vermilion City
cardPool.value: The coastal city of Vermilion is known for its bustling harbor and the legendary S.S. Anne cruise ship. The city also houses the Vermilion City Gym, where trainers can battle against the electric-type gym leader, Lt. Surge.

cardPool.title: Pallet Town
cardPool.value: It is located in southwestern Kanto, on the shore, and is known for being the hometown of Ash.

cardPool.title: Cerulean City
cardPool.value: Cerulean City, located in the Kanto region, is home to the famous Cerulean Gym and its leader, Misty. The city is known for its beautiful water features, including the Cerulean Cape and the nearby Seafoam Islands. However, rumors say that deep beneath the city lies a mysterious underwater cave system that few have ever explored...

cardPool.title: Cinnabar Island
cardPool.value: Cinnabar Island is a volcanic island in the Kanto region, known for its hot springs and research facility studying Pokemon fossils. The island was once home to a thriving population until a volcanic eruption destroyed most of the town, prompting its residents to rebuild their homes and businesses farther inland. The Cinnabar Gym is renowned for its leader, Blaine, who specializes in Fire-type Pokemon.

cardPool.title: Seafoam Islands
cardPool.value: The Seafoam Islands are a cluster of small islands located just off the coast of Kanto, said to be the home of Articuno, one of the legendary birds of Kanto. The islands are known for their treacherous icy terrain and the many ice-type pokemon that inhabit them, making them a challenging destination for trainers.

cardPool.title: Pewter City
cardPool.value: Pewter City, located in the Kanto region is known for its rich history and cultural significance in the world of Pokémon. The city is home to the Pewter Gym, led by the famous Brock, who is known for his strong rock-type Pokémon. The city also boasts a museum that houses some of the rarest and most ancient artifacts in the Pokémon world.

cardPool.title: Indigo Plateau
cardPool.value: The Indigo Plateau, also known as the Pokemon League, is a location in the Kanto region where the strongest trainers come together to challenge the Elite Four and the Pokemon Champion, in order to prove themselves as the best trainer in the region. It is said that only the most talented trainers are able to make it to the top of the plateau and claim the title of Pokemon Champion.

cardPool.title: Jesse
cardPool.value: Jesse is a cunning and charismatic member of Team Rocket. She's been with the organization for years and is one of the most skilled operatives in the group, often taking on leadership roles on missions. She has a sneaky streak and often uses her charm to manipulate others to do her bidding. Be careful around her, she's not to be underestimated.

cardPool.title: Mt. Hideaway
cardPool.value: Mt. Hideaway is a mysterious mountain that is said to be home to many rare and powerful Pokemon. The mountain is shrouded in mist and is said to be difficult to reach. It is believed that only the bravest and most skilled trainers are able to make it to the top.

cardPool.title: Celadon City
cardPool.value: Located in the region of Kanto, Celadon City is known for its large and luxurious department store, which sells a variety of items including rare Pokemon merchandise. The city is home to the prestigious Celadon Gym, where trainers can earn the Rainbow Badge by defeating the gym leader Erika, who specializes in grass-type Pokemon.

cardPool.title: Mt. Moon
cardPool.value: Mt. Moon is a massive mountain range in the Kanto region that is renowned for its plethora of rare, crystal-like stones. It is said that these stones have mystical properties and can enhance a Pokemon's abilities if used correctly. However, the mountain is treacherous to navigate, with winding tunnels full of dangerous Pokémon lurking in the shadows. Trainers brave enough to explore Mt. Moon could stand to gain a valuable edge over their opponents, but they need to be prepared for a challenging journey.

cardPool.title: Fuschia City
cardPool.value: Fuschia City is a bustling hub for trainers and adventurers alike. Known for its Safari Zone, the city offers a chance to capture rare and exotic Pokémon not commonly found in the wild. The Fuschia Gym, led by Koga, is also located in the city, known for his tough strategy and poison type Pokemon. Be sure to stop by the local Dojo and challenge the skilled martial artists for a chance to learn new techniques and earn their respect.

cardPool.title: Lavender Town
cardPool.value: Lavender Town is a small town situated at the base of a peak shrouded in eternal mist. The streets are lined with delicate purple flowers that seem to glimmer in the pale, ghostly light cast by the moon. The town is renowned for its Pokemon Tower, a massive structure filled with graves that is said to be haunted by the spirits of deceased Pokemon. Visitors are warned not to enter the tower without the proper protection, lest they fall victim to the vengeful ghosts.

cardPool.title: Bruno
cardPool.value: Bruno is a member of the Elite Four, an exclusive group of powerful trainers who guard the Pokémon League in Kanto. He specializes in Fighting-type Pokémon and is known for his unmatched strength and technique. Bruno is a wise and patient trainer, and he always encourages other trainers to embrace their inner strength. If you can manage to defeat him in battle, it's said that he'll recognize your immense potential as a trainer.

cardPool.title: Sabrina
cardPool.value: Sabrina is the Gym Leader of Saffron City and a powerful psychic type Pokemon trainer. Known for her calm demeanor, she possesses psychic abilities that allow her to communicate with her Pokemon beyond what is typically seen by other trainers. It is said that she has trained in the ways of the psychic arts with several powerful and mysterious adepts of the trade.

cardPool.title: Water Gym Leader
cardPool.value: Misty is the youngest of four sisters who all work as gym leaders in the Kanto region. As the Water Gym Leader, Misty specializes in training water type Pokémon and is known for her tough battles.

cardPool.title: Agatha
cardPool.value: Agatha is a seasoned trainer, known for her expertise in ghost-type Pokemon. She has been a member of the Elite Four for many years, but some say that she is as old as the League itself. Her experience and knowledge make her a formidable opponent for any trainer who dares to challenge her.

cardPool.title: Lance
cardPool.value: Lance is the master of dragon-type Pokémon and a powerful figure amongst trainers. He is the final member of the Elite four. He became the champion of the Pokémon League after years of intense training and dedication. Despite his gruff exterior, Lance has a heart for justice and protecting the world from evil organizations like Team Rocket. Many up-and-coming dragon trainers seek him out for advice and guidance.

cardPool.title: Koga
cardPool.value: Koga is a skilled ninja and the gym leader of Fuchsia City's gym. He uses Poison-type Pokémon for battles and was once one of the elite members of Team Rocket. After realizing the evil intentions of his organization, he left the team and decided to help Ash in his journey. Despite being stern and reserved, Koga is very loyal and protective of those he considers as his friends.

cardPool.title: Professor Oak
cardPool.value: Professor Oak is a renowned researcher and expert on the subject of Pokemon. He has dedicated his life to understanding the behaviors, abilities, and evolution of Pokemon. His lab serves as a hub for new trainers to receive their first Pokemon and begin their journey into the world of Pokemon. He also has a grandson named Gary who is known to be a gifted trainer, raising some of the strongest Pokemon in the region.

cardPool.title: Nurse Joy
cardPool.value: Nurse Joy is a helpful and kind-hearted Pokemon nurse that provides care and healing to all Pokemon that come through her doors. She is known for her expertise in treating Pokemon and ensuring their well-being. There are many Nurse Joys throughout different regions in the world of Pokemon, but they are all related and share a family resemblance.

cardPool.title: Giovanni
cardPool.value: Leader of the villainous Team Rocket organization, Giovanni is a cunning and ruthless businessman who will stop at nothing to achieve his goals. He is believed to be the architect of Team Rocket's plan to take over the world by capturing rare and powerful Pokémon. With his cool demeanor and sharp intellect, Giovanni is a formidable foe for any Pokémon or trainer who crosses his path.

cardPool.title: Meowth
cardPool.value: Meowth is a mischievous and cunning Pokémon. Known for its ability to speak human language, it often uses its power to trick others and get what it wants. Meowth is also fiercely loyal to Team Rocket, serving as their primary interpreter and strategist. It may seem like just a petty thief, but it has proven to be a valuable asset to the organization.

cardPool.title: Blaine
cardPool.value: Blaine is the Gym Leader of the Cinnabar Island Gym. He is an expert in Fire-type Pokemon and his gym is renowned for being one of the toughest challenges in the Kanto region. Blaine is also known for his research on the Mewtwo genome, which has put him at odds with the villainous Team Rocket.

cardPool.title: Erika
cardPool.value: Erika is the Gym Leader of Celadon City in the Kanto region. She is widely known as a kind and caring person who deeply loves her Pokemon, which are all Grass-type. Her specialty is the fragrance of her grass type Pokemon, which have been known to soothe the nerves of her challengers during battles.

cardPool.title: Officer Jenny
cardPool.value: Officer Jenny is a police officer who helps maintain law and order in the Kanto region. She always appears with her signature Growlithe by her side, giving her credibility and striking fear into the hearts of criminals. Officer Jenny's reputation precedes her, and many respect her for her unwavering dedication to justice.

cardPool.title: Lt. Surge
cardPool.value: Lt. Surge is a tough and experienced gym leader of Vermilion City in the Kanto region. He and his team of electric type Pokemon are known for their immense power and are feared by many trainers. Before becoming a gym leader, Surge was a member of the military, where he served as a lieutenant. It is said that he brings his military training into his gym battles, making him a formidable opponent for even the strongest of trainers.

cardPool.title: Brock
cardPool.value: Brock is the former Gym Leader of Pewter City in the Kanto region. He is a skilled trainer and also an experienced breeder of Rock-type Pokemon. He is known for his calm demeanor and practical approach to problem-solving.

cardPool.title: Lorelei
cardPool.value: One of the members of the Elite Four, Lorelei is a powerful Ice-type trainer who is feared and respected in the world of Pokémon. She has trained extensively in the harsh and unforgiving environment of the Seafoam Islands, where she developed her mastery of Ice-type moves. Her vast knowledge of Pokémon and her sharp strategic mind make her a formidable opponent that will test even the most skilled trainers.

cardPool.title: Ash
cardPool.value: Ash Ketchum is a young Pokemon trainer from Pallet Town, whose dream is to become a Pokemon Master. He is known for his adventurous nature, his boundless enthusiasm, and his never-give-up attitude. Ash is the main character in the Pokemon anime series and has caught and trained many powerful Pokemon throughout his journey.

cardPool.title: Pikachu
cardPool.value: Pikachu is the most famous and beloved of all Pokémon. Known for its electric abilities, it can generate powerful electric charges from the electric sacs on its cheeks. Pikachu is Ash's trusty sidekick and often leads the way in defeating Team Rocket's evil plans.

cardPool.title: James
cardPool.value: One of the members of Team Rocket, James is often seen donning a white suit and carrying a rose. Despite his villainous disposition, he has a soft spot for certain Pokemon and has been known to take care of them with great affection.

cardPool.title: Mew
cardPool.value: Mew is a legendary Pokemon known as the ancestor of all other Pokemon. It has the ability to use any move and can transform into any other Pokemon, making it incredibly powerful. Mew is also said to have the power to create new life, making it a highly sought after Pokemon by trainers and researchers alike.
